steps.name: brew tea
steps.note: Ceylon black tea is steeped in a cloth filter or fine strainer, then poured back through the leaves and left covered, in one recipe.
The milk and sugar go into the cups first and the tea is poured over them, in the same recipe.

links.name: Cooklang recipes: Hong Kong Milk Tea

sources.text: One home recipe for Hong Kong-style milk tea; it also says that Hong Kong's heritage listing knows no standard recipe, so shops differ.
